probe_stdout: CONFIRMED — call_edges() propagated IndexError from CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir instead of catching it and returning None. The specification requires that ALL initialization failures cause call_edges() to return None. Raised: Simulated codegraph index initialization failure
trigger_summary: call_edges() calls CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir() without try-except, so exceptions during initialization (e.g. IndexError) propagate instead of returning None as the spec requires.
